scientific_integrity: The main result is the joint annealed central limit theorem and moment limits for predictable cross-covariation, beyond the known first-order Brownian recoding criterion. A conditional coefficient-noise CLT, a harmonic-weight walk CLT, and an L2 expansion establish the law.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive integer degree and coefficient rate p_n=min(lambda/n^d,1/2) with independent rows and subsets.
The central second-order law is annealed only; its quenched analogue is not established.
First-order Brownian normality is background and not claimed as independently new; priority against all broader literature is not certified.
title: Second-order recoding fluctuations distinguish identical Brownian limits
